execution_frontier.name: Inference-only diagnosis of completed repaired-corpus R1 checkpoint
execution_frontier.summary: R1 completed all 128 governed phone-balanced batches on the local RTX 4060 workstation. The strict 125-row machine gate stopped at 104 PASS / 21 FAIL, all observed failures low-level, so R2 was correctly blocked. Full artifact analysis shows heterogeneous row-level amplitude collapse that the median-only probe guard did not catch, plus an inherited acceptance identity/output-filename collision (125 rows but only 95 unique IDs/files) and a warmstart-vs-R1 seed confound. Before any more training, run the prepared inference-only diagnostic on the completed R1 checkpoint with unique acceptance identities, five seed sweeps, and noise ablation.

probe_diagnosis.interpretation: Global/median amplitude remained acceptable, but at least one fixed-seed utterance deteriorated severely. Future collapse protection needs row-level/quantile protection in addition to the median guard.

acceptance_validator_defect.numeric_gate_effect: The 104/125 statistics were calculated immediately per inference and remain diagnostic; collisions affect persisted render identity/completeness, not the already-failing stop decision.
acceptance_validator_defect.promotion_rule: No future 125/125 machine result is promotable until the acceptance renderer uses 125 unique governed row IDs and 125 unique output filenames.

seed_confounded_comparison.effect: Direct per-row warmstart-to-R1 amplitude deltas conflate training change with stochastic inference seed change. Fixed-seed probe trajectories remain valid training-change evidence.

settled_architecture.frontend: DWC/PSS/CNS to engine-independent exact custom phoneme IDs; no English G2P at the acoustic boundary
